meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 每次回复前会自动回忆相关记忆，每轮结束后把新见解写入图结构记忆；记忆存在每个 agent group 的 .claude 挂载目录，容器重启后仍在。
howto.when: 当你要给运行默认 Claude provider 的 agent group 安装 mnemon 时触发；hooks 只在 --target claude-code 下生效，其他 provider（如 opencode）的 group 不适用。

say.text: 给这个 agent group 装上 mnemon 持久记忆
先确认这个 group 的 provider 是 claude 再装
重置这个 agent 的全部记忆
say.note: 停止容器并删除 mnemon/ 子目录

howto.what_en: After install, Claude recalls relevant past context before answering and stores new insights after each turn, backed by a graph memory written to the agent group's .claude mount so it survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Use when adding mnemon memory to an agent group running the default Claude provider. Hooks only fire under --target claude-code; groups with another provider (e.g. opencode) are skipped.

say_en.text: Add mnemon persistent memory to this agent group
say_en.note: Edits Dockerfile and entrypoint, then rebuilds the image

say_en.text: Check this group's provider is claude before adding mnemon
say_en.note: Greps container.json for the provider key

say_en.text: Reset all memory for this agent
say_en.note: Stops the container and deletes the mnemon/ subdirectory
